title: Spatial statistical machine learning models to assess the relationship between development vulnerabilities and educational factors in children in Queensland, Australia
summary: A spatial random-forest model fit small-area child development-vulnerability and preschool-attendance patterns better than aspatial comparators in Queensland. This is a bounded ecological association; no individual-level causal claim.
